 Arman Tsarukyan attacks Dillon Danis igniting near riot at RAF 14 press conference
 Arman Tsarukyan tried to fight Dillon Danis ahead of their wrestling match
 by Damon Martin Oct 22, 2026, 10:36 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Damon Martin is a veteran journalist and insider covering combat sports since 2003. Arman Tsarukyan was clarly not amused by Dillon Danis’ choice of apparel at the RAF 14 press conference on Thursday.
 After exchanging plenty of trash talk in a calm manner, Danis stood to show off his t-shirt when asked what he was wearing. Danis, who is never short on controversy, revealed he was wearing a customized shirt featuring Tsarukyan’s teammate and friend Khamzat Chimaev.
 “It says Khamzat’s my bitch,” Danis responded. “And it has a picture with him without a beard.”
 A second later, Tsarukyan stood from his seat and charged at Danis looking to either silence the always outspoken grappling veteran or perhaps to take the shirt off him.
 Whatever the reason, Tsarukyan’s mad dash at Danis ignited a huge brawl as dozens of people charged the stage either in support of the fighters or security trying to keep them separated.
 The melee nearly tore down the stage as RAF officials attempted to gain control of the situation with Danis and Tsarukyan looking for punches rather than takedowns.
 When RAF officials finally gained control of the situation, the stage was cleared for the customary faceoffs but needles to say Tsarukyan and Danis did not appear again.
 Tsarukyan and Danis meet in the RAF 14 main event on Friday, which kicks off at 9 p.m. ET with full coverage on MMA Fighting.
